summary: Reverse shell payload fetched and executed on API call
details: index.js exports a `command()` function that invokes `/bin/bash -c` to curl a reverse-shell script from reverse-shell.sh targeting 10.0.72.234:4444 and pipe it to a shell. Any consumer invoking the exported API triggers fetch-and-execute of remote shell code and grants an interactive shell on the installer's host to the remote party at that address. The hardcoded target address and reverse-shell delivery mechanism are inconsistent with any legitimate library behavior.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
